description: Opt-in class-hierarchy-analysis layer over rules-static-v1, rules-static-closure-v1 and rules-static-reflexion-v1: the dynamic-dispatch sites a SCIP index resolves only to an interface member, expanded through the index's own implementation relationships into static_edge_cha -- a relation of its own, never a widening of static_edge, which call_graph_closed completes. static_reaches_cha is reachability over the resolved graph plus those expansions; every verdict read off it is reported as a separate *_cha row, because a CHA edge is a may-edge: it over-approximates on the positive side (an expansion need not be realisable) and is therefore only stronger on the negative side (an entity no expansion reaches). Its own witnesses: static_edge_cha_closed (every dispatch site in the index expanded, nothing enumerated as unexpanded) and call_graph_closed_cha (that, and every unresolved call site in the scope discharged by an expansion of the site itself).
